scope: Limited source-path semantic review only; neither whole-package audit nor portability certification.
source_ref_warning: Refs can be mutable. Archive/file SHA256 identify reviewed bytes; no resolved commit is asserted.

cases.reviewed_scope: InputSocket construction and receive: UDP bind, poll/recvfrom, packet length and optional source-IP validation.
design_requirements: Receive-only binding with approved peer policy, packet codec, frame and queue bounds.
Host-owned transport is not a descriptor or send capability.
required_acceptance_checks: Reject foreign senders and malformed packets before delivery.
Report drops, discontinuities and timestamps; revocation wakes receive.

cases.reviewed_scope: CAN binding and sender: CAN/CAN-FD, identifier, length validation and timeout.
design_requirements: Bind approved bus, identifier mask, frame kind and payload schema; direction alone cannot constrain actuator effects.
Keep ioctl, socket options and interface provisioning inside the trusted provider.
required_acceptance_checks: Reject forbidden IDs, formats, DLC and command values before transmission.
Separate receive, regular command and emergency stop grants.

cases.reviewed_scope: Writer opening, append, splitting and SQLite configuration. Bag-size thresholds rotate output and do not cap cumulative storage.
design_requirements: Bound total live/reserved storage across rotation, metadata, journal/WAL, staging, cache and compression output.
Reserve worst-case write envelope before admission; approved backend profiles replace guest PRAGMA strings.
required_acceptance_checks: Rotation, metadata and concurrent writers cannot exceed total reservation.
Exhaustion exposes chosen stop/reject/wait/loss behavior without false success.
Account for failed append cleanup and commit.

cases.reviewed_scope: YAML image references and image/YAML output through separate native writes.
design_requirements: Immutable dependency bundle with approved codecs and bounded decoding.
Reserve and commit all map members as one generation; relative paths confer no recursive directory access.
required_acceptance_checks: Reject references, symlinks and traversal outside the bundle.
Second-write failure never publishes mixed generations.
Bound decoded dimensions and encoded buffers.

cases.reviewed_scope: Provider configuration, prompt/image serialization, curl response accumulation, logging and conversion of text to boolean.
design_requirements: Host owns endpoint/credentials; source-data egress and provider authorization are separate.
Bound encoded images, request/response bytes, tokens, concurrency and deadlines; diagnostics are private.
Parsed model output remains data/proposal with independent control authorization.
required_acceptance_checks: Model output cannot grant authority, execute shell or select arbitrary paths.
Oversized responses stay within reservation; revoked/cancelled jobs cannot publish stale output.
Default inspection excludes credentials, prompts and images.

cases.reviewed_scope: Client-selected topic/type/QoS, service calls, optional topic glob checks and throttle/queue inputs.
design_requirements: Authorize resolved source/destination names, types and directions independently.
Connections confer no graph-wide access; correlation, cancellation and deadlines are explicit.
required_acceptance_checks: Remapping cannot bypass either endpoint grant.
Bound echo, replay and expired correlation.
Sampling explicitly weakens delivery guarantees.

cases.reviewed_scope: HTTP listener/routes, streamer selection, topic queries and shutdown selection.
design_requirements: Separate listener provisioning, camera reads and per-viewer egress.
Bind topic/codec/resolution/budget and stop-session ownership.
required_acceptance_checks: Image read cannot create a public listener or authorize another viewer.
Reject another session's stop ID.
Bound decoded/encoded frames, viewers and backpressure.

cases.reviewed_scope: TCPROS connect/listen/accept: purpose-specific transport still uses negotiated host/port values.
design_requirements: Trusted ROS provider negotiates under deployment-domain and peer policy.
Guest sees topic/service/action semantics without a general socket fallback.
required_acceptance_checks: A topic grant cannot contact unrelated destinations.
Check peer policy and revoked route generations during negotiation.

cases.reviewed_scope: URL selection/parsing: serial, UDP bind/remote/broadcast, TCP client/server and protocol IDs. Underlying transport implementations excluded.
design_requirements: Approved vehicle-link profiles bind host-owned device/peer and protocol identity.
Message/command schema authorization is independent of transport admission.
required_acceptance_checks: Guest cannot replace a serial profile with a listener/broadcast URL.
Check system/component ID, message ID and command envelope before forwarding.

cases.reviewed_scope: Plugin selection/loading and publisher plugin enumeration. Individual codec implementations excluded.
design_requirements: Immutable approved codec/plugin IDs with capability/dependency closure.
No guest native-library path or plugin discovery authority.
required_acceptance_checks: Unknown IDs or undeclared effects fail closed.
Bound decoded dimensions and expansion before allocation.

cases.reviewed_scope: Memory lock/affinity/priority and measured-period read/update/write with simulation/wall-clock scheduling.
design_requirements: Admit continuous cycles with reserved capacity and explicit watchdog/safe stop.
Deployment owns scheduling; attenuation explicitly changes timing/completeness guarantees.
required_acceptance_checks: Rate limits cannot silently skip an admitted phase.
Revocation/deadline failure invokes safe stop.
Distinguish simulation-time jumps and wall-clock timeout.

cases.reviewed_scope: Package resources, parameter rewrite, environment input, component/executable selection, remapping and respawn setup.
design_requirements: Trusted immutable component/configuration manifest and explicit lifecycle replace ambient process authority.
Resolve remapping before authorization; no guest shell or inherited environment grant.
required_acceptance_checks: Respawn cannot restore a revoked generation or change an approved binary.
Configuration rewriting is a bounded private transaction.
Substitution/remapping cannot escape deployment scope.

cases.reviewed_scope: Original plugin declaration and hardware configuration: peer and reverse/script/trajectory endpoints, sealed script and recipe dependencies, headless program transmission, calibration/model checks and an asynchronous worker. Configuration already constructs the connected driver before on_activate.
design_requirements: Load the unchanged vendor plugin only inside its matching external ROS/pluginlib host and sealed dependency closure; platform metadata never embeds its driver.

Treat configure/connect as potentially effectful: deny the actuation-capable network route until an explicit current control epoch and independent stop are admitted. A no-op on_activate cannot define the security boundary.
Pin each directed peer/listener and script/recipe artifact, including reverse/trajectory/script-command roles, and reserve background thread/CPU/NUMA resources.
Configured model/firmware/calibration mismatch policy must be explicit; a logged warning is not proof that activation is safe.
required_acceptance_checks: With zero authority, construct neither a connected original driver nor a script-enabled network route.
Exercise original binary/pluginlib initialization, background thread failure, stale reverse connections and process-tree termination in the target simulator and hardware.
Verify that headless/script transmission requires separate semantics from telemetry; late old-epoch traffic cannot reactivate motion.

cases.reviewed_scope: Original plugin ABI, connection/model creation, real-time configuration fallback, active-control initialization with automatic recovery, stop and executor teardown. Does not review libfranka transport implementation or physical braking.
design_requirements: Require a matching external host for the original native plugin; Wasm receives bounded typed state/command messages and no Model or hardware pointers.

A control startup may internally clear a fault and retry. Separate recovery/rearm authority from start/observe, with enforcement at an independently trusted command gate if the unchanged binary cannot suppress that behavior.
A stable real-time profile cannot silently accept the vendor fallback that ignores real-time enforcement; admit a qualified scheduling profile or refuse before activation.
Driver stop/reset/destructor and process exit are not independent stopped-state evidence; old command epochs remain fenced after automatic recovery.
required_acceptance_checks: Inject ControlException and verify missing recovery authority prevents any fresh effect even when the original library retries internally.
Qualify normal and non-real-time kernels independently and reject missing stable reservations before control admission.
Verify isolated executor/service teardown, native crash/hang, and independent receiver stop feedback with actual vendor ABI and hardware.

cases.reviewed_scope: Launch subprocess creation, shell/environment selection, signal escalation and respawn loop. Respawn can repeat without a finite retry ceiling and does not establish fresh robot control authority.
design_requirements: Exact immutable executable, configuration, dependencies and permitted environment; no guest-selected shell or native path.
Process restart and device activation require separate authorization and fresh incarnation/receiver epoch; launch respawn must never restore motion automatically.
Retain first failure and unknown effects across stop, close, retry and restart admission; launcher exit alone is not process-tree or hardware-stop proof.
required_acceptance_checks: Deny restart before independent cleanup and rearm evidence; stale requests cannot resurrect old authority.
Inject launcher, namespace-identity, IPC and descendant failures before and after readiness.
Verify finite restart/log/process reservations and explicit behavior on exhaustion.

cases.reviewed_scope: Managed/unmanaged instance creation loads libraries on demand; package-prefix and library-name variants determine candidate native paths. A closed ROSv2 message backend is not pluginlib ABI compatibility.
design_requirements: Resolve ABI-specific plugin metadata and exact dependency closure before launch; seal each executable/library and forbid mutable fallback paths.
Load every native plugin, constructor and vendor dependency only inside the independently confined external host.
Update/rollback creates a new external incarnation; old C++ objects, symbols, handles and grants are never revived.
required_acceptance_checks: Qualify actual pluginlib/vendor ABI hosts separately from the closed message fixture.
Reject changed package prefixes, dependency substitution, unavailable ABI and late native-code mappings outside the selected profile.
Exercise plugin constructors/destructors, unmanaged lifetimes, crash and teardown using real original vendor binaries.
